reason: Provides agent-facing tools to search, inspect, and browse DSH plugins using npm, GitHub repository metadata, and a curated awesome list.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH agent 内搜索、查询和浏览来自 npm、GitHub 及精选清单的插件信息。
summaries.en: Provides DSH agents with tools to search, inspect, and browse plugin information from npm, GitHub, and a curated list.

capabilities: Searches npm and a curated plugin list
Retrieves npm and GitHub repository metadata
Browses a curated plugin ecosystem list
Uses external network requests to read plugin information
